title: Endpoint Outdated Software Payload (AG-036) v1
description: Wire contract for the AG-036 outdated-software probe block carried under the COLLECT_INVENTORY result at details.inventory.outdatedSoftware. Source of truth = platform-agent internal/inventory/outdated_software.go OutdatedSoftwareResult (schemaVersion=1; probe PR #38 merged sha a29eef49; truncation semantics finalized by AG-036 PR #40 merged sha e64c131). Backend ingest (outdated-software persist/query) and web view MUST conform to this shape. Redaction boundary (machine-enforced here, agent-enforced at source via TestOutdatedSoftwarePackage_JSONKeys): per-package wire fields are EXACTLY packageId + installedVersion + availableVersion — NO display name / publisher / install location / license / download URL. The probe is read-only ('winget upgrade --include-returning-apps --source winget'); it NEVER mutates package state. Thresholds/caps (MaxUpgrade=512) are agent-side const and NOT payload-configurable. upgradeCount semantics (PR #40 contract debt resolution, option a): upgradeCount is the returned/capped count (== len(upgrade), bounded [0, maxUpgrade]); upgradeTruncated is the AUTHORITATIVE 'list incomplete' signal; the true pending total is intentionally NOT carried on the wire when truncated. See docs/faz-22-outdated-software-contract-v1.md §'Decision record'.

schemaVersion.description: Payload schema version. const 1 pins AG-036 v1. A new shape requires a new version + a new schema $id (see forward-compat rule in docs/faz-22-outdated-software-contract-v1.md).

supported.description: false on non-Windows runtimes (the agent still emits canonical OS metadata so the backend persists 'probe not supported here' instead of treating absence as a failed ingest).

probeComplete.description: true only when probeErrors is empty AND sourceUsed != none (fail-closed: any probeError or a no-source run flips this false; consumers MUST NOT render an incomplete probe as 'fully up to date').

upgradeCount.description: Count of upgradeable packages RETURNED in 'upgrade' (equals len(upgrade)). Bounded [0, maxUpgrade=512] — machine-enforced here (maximum:512) to stay in lockstep with the agent cap (MaxOutdatedPackages), the backend ingest policy (OutdatedSoftwarePayloadPolicy enforces [0,512]) and the DB CHECK (upgrade_count <= max_upgrade). When upgradeTruncated=true the host had MORE than maxUpgrade pending upgrades and upgradeCount is the CAPPED count (== maxUpgrade), NOT the true pending total — the true total is intentionally NOT carried on the wire (read upgradeTruncated, the authoritative signal). When upgradeTruncated=false this IS the exact pending total. See the upgradeCount semantics decision in docs/faz-22-outdated-software-contract-v1.md.

upgrade.description: Upgradeable package entries. ALWAYS serializes as [] (never null). Capped at maxUpgrade (512).

upgradeTruncated.description: AUTHORITATIVE 'list is incomplete' signal (finalized by platform-agent AG-036 PR #40 / e64c131). true ⟺ the host had MORE than maxUpgrade classifiable upgrades, so the returned 'upgrade' list and 'upgradeCount' are capped at maxUpgrade and the true pending total is NOT on the wire. false ⟺ the returned list is complete and 'upgradeCount' is the exact pending total. Consumers MUST treat this flag as the truncation source of truth — NOT the legacy 'upgradeCount==maxUpgrade' heuristic (which false-positives at exactly-512). Legacy nuance: rows produced by PRE-#40 agents may carry upgradeTruncated=false even when capped (agent version is not on the wire), so a consumer reading historical rows MAY use 'upgradeCount==maxUpgrade' only as a conservative legacy fallback; for current agents upgradeTruncated is authoritative.

sourceUsed.description: winget = read-only 'winget upgrade --include-returning-apps --source winget'. none = no probe ran (unsupported platform).

probeErrors.description: Optional (omitempty at source). Any entry flips probeComplete=false.

outdatedPackage.description: Per-package wire shape. EXACTLY these three keys — the redaction boundary (no display name / publisher / install location / license / download URL) is machine-enforced both here (additionalProperties:false) and at source (TestOutdatedSoftwarePackage_JSONKeys).

packageId.description: Stable winget package id (e.g. '7zip.7zip', 'Microsoft.VisualStudioCode'). No whitespace — it is an id, not a human-facing display name. The only package-level correlation key on the wire.

availableVersion.description: Available (newer) version string (public, non-PII). The from/to pair is what makes the 'outdated' signal actionable.

summary.description: Bounded operator-facing text; static phrasing; NEVER a raw errno dump, filesystem path, or package display name.

probeErrors.summary: outdated-software probe not supported on this runtime
